info.title: Lever Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date
info.description:
Scrape open jobs from any Lever job board and return only postings created since a date or window (24h, 7d, 30d). Title, location, team, workplace type, URL, description. Pay per result.

More: https://apify.com/publicrecords/lever-jobs-scraper

Input.title: Lever Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date

companies.title: Lever site names
companies.description: The site name in the board URL: https://jobs.lever.co/<site>. One per line, or paste the URLs.

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Add the plain-text job description to every posting.

post.summary: Run Lever Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date
post.description: Runs the job and returns the result rows as JSON (waits up to 280 s).
